non_code_sources_of_difference.rule: MAPPED. Build F3 compiled tensor_fork_apa_wt_p1f2 and Build PF compiles tensor_fork_apa_wt_p1pf2, so nvcc path-derived names differ. In symbol names AND in body text (call targets), each of these token classes is replaced by a fixed placeholder: (a) <digits>_GLOBAL__N__<8 hex>_ (mangled anonymous namespace with its length prefix, e.g. tc33_GLOBAL__N__...) -> <prefix>N_GLOBAL__N__H_; (b) _GLOBAL__N__<8 hex>_ without a length prefix -> _GLOBAL__N__H_; (c) __nv_static_<digits>__<8 hex>_ -> __nv_static_N__H_ (the counter and the hash). Pattern set: P1-D apa_p1d_sass_a1.PATTERNS widened by the lead check artifacts/apa_p1f3/lead_f3_sass_check.py (tensor_fork_apa_wt_p1f2) to any length prefix. The mapped symbol key must stay unique per build (asserted; a collision is a FAIL).

MAPPED: the per-build _cu_<8 hex> symbol suffix with an optional _<n> counter is replaced by _cu_H (names and bodies). Build F3 built in tensor_fork_apa_wt_p1f2/artifacts/apa_p1f3/build_F3, Build PF builds in this worktree's artifacts/apa_p1pf2/build_PF. Uniqueness asserted as above.
